near.opening: I've come up from Gonzales. There are Mexican soldiers on the far bank of the Guadalupe, across from the town. They have come for the cannon, and the town has told them no.

far.opening: I've come from the fork of the road, and I did not see any of this myself. Perla Zamarripa put it in my hands there, and had it from another rider before that, out of Gonzales. There are Mexican soldiers on the far bank of the Guadalupe, across from the town. They came for the cannon, and the town has told them no.

far.sawIt: No. Perla Zamarripa did not either. It was through 3 hands before mine, and I never met whoever it was that saw it. I am telling you what I was told, out of Gonzales.
